chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from al-Nadr, from Hisham, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, that he said:
Concerning a man who catches the Imam while he is in ruku', so the man says the takbir while standing upright, then goes into ruku' before the Imam raises his head: he has indeed caught that rak'ah.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: caught up with or attained in time
key_terms.الرَّكْعَةَ: the unit of salat (prayer) that is counted as attained
key_terms.الْإِمَامَ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.رَاكِعٌ: being in the state of ruku' (bowing)

ai.seo_question: When does a latecomer catch the rak'ah in congregational salat (prayer) if the Imam is in ruku'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about joining congregational salat (prayer) while the Imam is already in ruku'. If a person pronounces the takbir while standing upright and then enters ruku' before the Imam rises, that rak'ah counts for him.
